crash test.say: pass a crash test · crash test results

auto service.say: at the auto service · an auto service center
auto service.note: Americans usually say "auto repair shop" or "garage".

audio player.say: download an audio player · a built-in audio player

print screen.say: press print screen · take a print screen
print screen.note: Usually the name of the key; the picture itself is usually called a "screenshot".

gay pride.say: at gay pride · a gay pride march

fan fiction.say: write fan fiction · read fan fiction
ex: She writes fan fiction about her favorite TV show.
I read fan fiction online almost every night.
Where can I post my fan fiction for free?
Many popular writers started with fan fiction as teenagers.
fan fiction.note: Also written as one word: "fanfiction". Uncountable: some fan fiction.

internet forum.say: on an internet forum · post on a forum
internet forum.note: People usually just say "forum" or "online forum".

audio file.say: send an audio file · play an audio file

audio guide.say: rent an audio guide · listen to the audio guide

IT specialist.say: work as an IT specialist · call the IT specialist

footage.say: security camera footage · footage of the storm
footage.note: Uncountable: some footage, a lot of footage (not "a footage").

invite code.say: enter an invite code · send an invite code

streaming service.say: on a streaming service · subscribe to a streaming service

paradise.say: a paradise for surfers · in paradise
ex: This small island is a paradise for divers.
For little kids, this toy store is paradise.
Many religions describe paradise as a beautiful garden.
Is this beach really a paradise, or just good photos?
paradise.note: Also any very beautiful, happy place: "a paradise for surfers".

nail art.say: get nail art · do nail art

dressing.say: salad dressing · dressing on the side
dressing.note: Most often salad sauce; also a bandage on a wound, and part of "dressing room".

jazz festival.say: at the jazz festival · go to a jazz festival

photo portrait.say: have a photo portrait taken · a family photo portrait

blonde.note: "Blond" is also used, especially for men. "A blonde" is a woman with blonde hair.

versus.say: A versus B · price versus quality

internet provider.say: call your internet provider · switch internet providers

life hack.say: a simple life hack · share a life hack
ex: Here's a simple life hack for packing a small suitcase.
This life hack saves me time every morning.
Do you know a good life hack for cleaning windows?
My favorite kitchen life hack is freezing herbs in oil.

sketch show.say: watch a sketch show · on a sketch show

cheat code.say: use a cheat code · enter a cheat code

ex: He works on the back end of our website.
The back end stores all the user data.
We need a developer for the back end of the app.
The app is slow because of back end problems.
back end.note: Also written "backend". It can also mean the rear part of something, like a car.

high life.note: Usually used with "the": "live the high life".

ex: I learned this recipe from a TV food show.
The food show visits a different restaurant every week.
He's a judge on a popular food show.
Is there a good food show on TV tonight?
food show.note: Americans often say "cooking show" for a TV show about making food.

center back.note: British spelling is "centre back"; also written "center-back".

ex: The company is on a road show to meet investors.
The band's road show comes to our city in June.
We visited five cities during the road show.
When does the road show stop in our city?
She wore a red dress a la old movie stars.
We had a picnic a la France, with bread and cheese.
He decorated his apartment a la the 1970s.
The café serves breakfast a la Paris, with croissants and coffee.
a la.note: Often written "à la"; means "in the style of".

super show.note: Not a set phrase in English; say "a big show" or "a spectacular show".

ex: Good self-management is important when you work from home.
The training covers time management and self-management skills.
Self-management helps you meet deadlines without stress.
How can I improve my self-management at work?

let's player.note: Rare; "gaming YouTuber" or "streamer" is more common.

ex: She traced the drawing on a light box.
Our store has a bright light box sign above the door.
The designer checked the old film on a light box.
Can we put our menu in a light box?

radio center.note: Not a set phrase in English; say "radio station" or "broadcasting center".

smart house.note: "Smart home" is the more common phrase.

grand final.note: Mostly used in Australia and Europe; Americans often say "championship game".

photo bank.note: "Stock photo site" is more common in American English.

hate speech.note: Uncountable: "hate speech is", not "a hate speech".
